title: Personal Loans Refinance Loans: Calculation of the Amount Financed
content:
## Calculation

The payoff to be covered is the payoff amount of the refinance-purpose payoff quote on the loan being refinanced dated on the application date. The refinance fee percent is the grade's origination fee percent less the grade's refinance origination fee reduction, never below zero. The origination fee is withheld from the amount financed, so the amount financed is the payoff to be covered divided by one minus the refinance fee percent over 100. That amount is rounded to the cent and then rounded up to a whole dollar (an amount already in whole dollars is kept as it is).

The grade is the application's grade, the grade of the loan being refinanced at which the application is prequalified; its origination fee percent and refinance origination fee reduction are the Personal Loans grade figures. The refinance fee percent is settled before the division, and the cent and whole-dollar rounding come only at the end. The amount financed is never below the payoff to be covered, so it is always above 0.00.

## Worked figure (hypothetical Personal Loan Grade C loan)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| payoff to be covered | 10000.00 |
| grade origination fee percent | 3.99 |
| grade refinance origination fee reduction | 1.00 |
| refinance fee percent | 2.99 |
| 10000.00 divided by one minus 0.0299 | 10308.2156... |
| rounded to the cent | 10308.22 |
| rounded up to a whole dollar | 10309.00 |

## Rounding points (hypothetical amounts)

| Amount after the division | Rounded to the cent | Amount financed |
|---|---|---|
| 10308.2156 | 10308.22 | 10309.00 |
| 10308.0004 | 10308.00 | 10308.00 |
| 10308.0051 | 10308.01 | 10309.00 |
